rule.name: SpringNoSwallowedTransactionException
rule.message: Rethrow a broad or persistence exception caught inside a @Transactional method, or catch it in the caller. Swallowed there, by a catch without throw, it leaves the transaction rollback-only, so the commit fails anyway.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] or ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')] or (@Visibility != 'public' and (let $name := @Name, $arity := @Arity, $varargs := @Varargs return exists(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional')]] //MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]][@MethodName = $name] [count(ArgumentList/*) = $arity or ($varargs and count(ArgumentList/*) >= $arity - 1)])))] //CatchClause[not(.//ThrowStatement)][not(ancestor::LambdaExpression or ancestor::ClassBody[parent::ConstructorCall])] [CatchParameter//ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Exception') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.RuntimeException') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Throwable') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.TransactionException') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.PersistenceException'))]]
